quests.name: Sacramental Time
quests.description: In your player profile, add the sacramental time.

quests.name: LDS account
quests.description: Get your member number with your ward clerk and create a LDS account, remember to keep your password safe! Afterwards, save the username on the player profile.

quests.name: FamilySearch account
quests.description: Access the familysearch account and create an account, preferable with your LDS account and then save the link/username on the player profile.

quests.name: Temple Recommendation
quests.description: Have a meeting with a member of the bishopric to request to get your temple recommendation. Then enter the due date on you player profile.

quests.name: Patriarchal Blessing
quests.description: Have a meeting with a member of the bishopric to request a meeting with the Patriarch of your stake in order to receive your patriarchal blessing. After you receive yours go to the player profile and set as received.

quests.name: Receive a Calling
quests.description: Have a meeting with a member of the bishopric to inform that your are willing to serve in the Lord's work here. After your receive a calling and/or a designation go to the player profile and enter it there.

quests.name: Enter the Temple
quests.description: Now you can enter the Temple to do your own ordinances, so request to your bishop a new recommendation in order to do your own initiatory and endowment in the Temple. After you do these ordinances enter the value in your player profile.

quests.name: Sealing to Eternity
quests.description: Congratulations for your marriage! This is a important step in your life, but for the eternity you need to seal yourself to your spouse. So after you are sealed to your spouse, please enter the date on your player profile.

quests.name: Renovate Temple Recommendation
quests.description: Have a meeting with a member of the bishopric to request a meeting to renovate your temple recommendation. Then enter the new date in your profile.

quests.name: Online Tithe
quests.description: After you receive you receive your first payment you should take 10% of it and return to the Lord and a generous fast offer to help those in need. A much simpler and secure way to do this is to do it online, so please contact your ward clerk to learn how to this and then mark this quest as completed.

quests.name: Add info to FamilySearch (1)
quests.description: After you create your FamilySearch account you need to include your own personal information in FamilySearch. to start the work. Register this quest as done after you finishing here.

quests.name: Add info to FamilySearch (2)
quests.description: After including your own information, now we must go a bit higher in your family tree. Include your parents' information in FamilySearch. Register this quest as done after you finishing here.

quests.name: Add info to FamilySearch (3)
quests.description: We are almost there, please include your grandparents' information in FamilySearch. Register this quest as done after you finishing here.

quests.name: Add info to FamilySearch (4)
quests.description: Include your great-grandparents' information in FamilySearch. Then, register this quest as done after you finishing here. After you finishes this, you will be at what we are in what we set as the minimum as church members and your family tree grows much higher than this, so keep working.

quests.name: Reference to the Missionaries
quests.description: We can help the full time missionaries in many ways, but in this quest you should just give them a reference, a name of a friend, colleague, neighbor, someone you met in the bus, you name it, just give a contact of someone that you feel that would be benefited of knowing the missionaries. Then mark this mission as completed.

quests.name: Sacramental Talk
quests.description: From time to time the bishopric will invite you to give a talk, or to bear testimony in the sacramental meeting. Accept it and be sure to be prepare early and practice so you don't get nervous. Then mark this mission as completed.

quests.name: Strength of Youth
quests.description: Read and study the For the Strength of Youth booklet thoroughly. Reflect on its teachings and principles, and consider how they apply to your daily life. Set personal goals inspired by the booklet to strengthen your faith, make wise choices, and serve others. Create custom quests based on these goals to help you grow spiritually, develop Christlike attributes, and prepare for future opportunities to lead and uplift those around you.

quests.name: Memorize Theme
quests.description: Memorize the theme for the Young Men or Young Women organization. Reflect on its meaning and how it applies to your life. Use the theme as a guide to set personal goals, strengthen your testimony, and inspire others by living its principles daily.

quests.name: Activities (YM/YW/Combined)
quests.description: Actively participate in Young Men, Young Women, or combined youth activities to develop friendships, strengthen your testimony, serve others, and grow as a disciple of Jesus Christ. Use these opportunities to set personal goals, learn new skills, and support your peers in living gospel principles.

quests.name: YSAs Activities
quests.description: Actively participate in and help prepare Young Single Adult (YSA) activities to build meaningful friendships, strengthen your testimony, and serve others. Use these opportunities to develop leadership skills, set personal and spiritual goals, and prepare for future responsibilities in the Church and community. Let YSA activities inspire you to grow as a disciple of Jesus Christ, support your peers, and make a positive impact in the lives of those around you.

quests.name: Guidance from the Bishopric
quests.description: Schedule and attend an interview with the bishopric for personal guidance, regardless of your current situation. Use this opportunity to discuss your spiritual progress, set meaningful goals, seek counsel for challenges, and receive encouragement to grow in faith and service. Let this experience inspire you to strengthen your relationship with Jesus Christ, prepare for future responsibilities, and make a positive impact in your family, church, and community.
